questions.stem: Explain the difference between a relation schema and an instance of that schema.
markingGuide: A relation schema is the blueprint of a table, specifying its name, attributes, and domains.
An instance is a specific set of data that conforms to the schema.
The schema remains constant, while instances can vary as data is added or removed.
